title: Use exponential backoff for payment retries
body:
## Decision: payment retry policy

Choice: Exponential backoff with jitter
Alternatives rejected: Fixed interval retries, Immediate retry storm
Assumptions: Provider is at-least-once
AI tool: claude-code
Model: claude-opus-4-8
Justifies: payments/retry.py:40-72
diff:
diff --git a/payments/retry.py b/payments/retry.py
+++ b/payments/retry.py
